description: The sweeper tests never assert the empty-user-list edge case. makeSweep*Handler with zero users should still step.run('list') and step.sendEvent with an EMPTY array (or skip sendEvent). inngest/functions.js:33-36 will call step.sendEvent('fan', []) on zero users — sending an empty events array to Inngest is a potential no-op or error depending on the SDK; no test covers it. Likewise no test covers a user row MISSING `uid` (the concurrency key 'event.data.uid' silently becomes undefined -> all such events share one concurrency bucket / unkeyed). Tests only use stub users that always have uid.

evidence.snippet: const users = await step.run("list", listUsers); await step.sendEvent("fan", users.map((u) => ({ name: "lm/wake.user", data: u })));
